summary: Mottainai is a fast, clever card game from the designer of Glory to Rome, where every card can be used as an action, a resource, or a building material depending on how you play it. It rewards tight tactical thinking about how your discarded actions help the next player, creating a tense push-pull rhythm in a very short playtime.
criticised: rules can be confusing to first-time players
iconography-heavy cards are a barrier to entry
some feel it lacks the depth of Glory to Rome

interaction.detail: Players choose an action for everyone to follow, meaning your choices directly enable or restrict what opponents can do next turn, while each player still maintains their own private tableau of materials and works.

win_criteria: Most points, one or two sources

scoring.why: The bulk of your score comes from the point values printed on completed Works, with a secondary contribution from leftover materials/goods at game end.
scoring.how_you_win: You use multi-purpose cards to gather materials and complete Works cards; the game ends when a player finishes enough Works or the deck runs out, and the player with the most points from completed Works (plus leftover goods) wins.
